definitions.explanation: Official permission to do something, especially as granted by an authority; a document proving such permission.

examples.japanese: {運転|うんてん}{免許|めんきょ}を{取|と}った。
{免許|めんきょ}を{更新|こうしん}しなければならない。
examples.english: I need to renew my license.

examples.japanese: {免許|めんきょ}{証|しょう}を{見|み}せてください。

notes:
USAGE: {免許|めんきょ} refers to official licenses or permits, most commonly driving licenses.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{運転|うんてん}{免許|めんきょ} (driver's license)
・{免許|めんきょ}{証|しょう} (license card/document)
・{免許|めんきょ}を{取|と}る (to get a license)
・{免許|めんきょ}を{更新|こうしん}する (to renew a license)
・{免許|めんきょ}を{取|と}り{消|け}す (to have one's license revoked)
・{無|む}{免許|めんきょ} (without a license, unlicensed)

RELATED:
・{免許|めんきょ}{皆伝|かいでん} - mastery certification (in traditional arts)
